exposure: Placental thickness (PT) in 2nd trimester ultrasound (18-21 weeks)
Placental thickness (PT) in 3rd trimester ultrasound (32-34 weeks)
cohort: The study included 60 singleton pregnant women whose placental thickness was measured during the 2nd and 3rd trimesters, and whose neonatal outcomes were recorded at birth.
finding: There was a meaningful connection between placental thickness in the 2nd and 3rd trimester sonography and neonatal birth weight, but no association was found with pregnancy number, APGAR at birth, or maternal PT.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken during the 2nd trimester (18-21 weeks), 3rd trimester (32-34 weeks), and at neonatal birth.
